LIBERTY CHRISTIAN SCHOOL · ARGYLE, TEXAS

Warrior Football
Trailer Wrap Concepts

Two directions for the 5×8 cargo trailer, built from the school’s own Texas warrior mark, the BE ONE Warrior Football lockup, and the team block font. Each concept covers all four surfaces. Photo mockups use the actual trailer.

CONCEPT A

Blackout

Bold and modern. Navy-to-black gradient with an angled steel shard, a gold-and-white speed slash, and WARRIORS running the full length of the panel so it reads from across a parking lot. The Texas warrior mark anchors the front; a ghosted helmet fills the rear half. Gold is used sparingly as a championship accent.

READS AT SPEEDWARRIORS is roughly 11″ cap height — legible from 150+ feet.
GOLD ACCENTNew to the palette. Ties the side stripe to the championship years on the back.
HIDES DIRTDark base keeps a towed trailer looking clean between washes.
CONCEPT B

Classic

Collegiate and traditional — the DNA of the wrap you already have, tightened up. White-to-navy diagonal, the mark in navy on the light half, an italic serif school name over a block WARRIORS. The rear carries five championship pennants instead of a year list.

FAMILIARClosest to the existing trailer and the school's print identity.
PENNANTS SCALEAdd a sixth banner after the next title without redrawing the panel.
TWO-TONELight half keeps the trailer from reading as a solid dark box.

  • Panel dimensions are nominal for a 5×8 Carry-On — have the wrap shop measure the actual flat area before final artwork.
  • The rear mockups show artwork running under the license plate and latches. Real layouts shift the type up or in to clear that hardware.
  • Championship years: 1994, 1996, 2007, 2023, 2024 — five TAPPS titles.
  • Type is the school block font plus Oswald and Playfair Display; the mark and BE ONE lockup come straight from the supplied .ai / .eps vector files.
